exceptions.trigger: Receiver not reachable on either rail
Creditor routing number not instant-payments enabled, participant unavailable, or rail INACTIVE
exceptions.customer_experience: Verify-routing-number call returns instant_payments_enabled=NO / participant_available=NO / payment_rail=INACTIVE; client should not submit the credit transfer
exceptions.bank_handling: No payment created; client falls back to ACH or wire via other Gateway APIs
exceptions.resolution: Re-check later or use another rail

exceptions.trigger: Credit transfer REJECTED by network or receiving bank
exceptions.customer_experience: status REJECTED with code IN01/IN02/MM20/MM21 or NARR (free-form text from the receiving bank)
exceptions.bank_handling: 'Wells Fargo does not control or validate' NARR content; 'If you are troubleshooting or considering a retry due to this field, please contact Gateway Customer Support before proceeding'
exceptions.resolution: Contact Gateway Customer Support; retry only after guidance

assessment: Bank page explicitly claims instant send over both RTP and FedNow via API; portal UI for instant payments and commercial RfP not evidenced (dedicated pages blocked).
